inherited.negative: C rejects, each Jaccard <=0.25, spillover <=25% of smaller core, both delays.
inherited.recurrent: Within-core count >=core size and density >=3*pool density for both cores.
inherited.retention: Unchanged Stage 1 criterion 8: full A at 60 seconds has Jaccard >=0.8 with A; B also reported.
inherited.completion: Each of four fixed halves at both delays >=0.8 and gain >=0.25 vs untrained on the same core.

continued.reference: Frozen stopping cores for specificity, spillover, completion, retention and within-core median.
continued.drift: Jaccard(frozen stopping core, contemporaneous epoch-120 core) >=0.8 for BOTH A/B.
continued.contemporaneous: Report separately; never substitute into gate 11.

population: Declare every feature ID as an endpoint before addNeuron. Native per-ID seeded assignment applies only to ordinary pool cells. P=round(500/(1-f)); report actual E/I. No type reassignment.
v1: Exact Stage 1g scaffold parameters: g1, w0=1.1, maxWeight=1.65, maxSynapses8, jitter15; diagnostic stopping horizon/continued gate extends to120. One-hit cells are also direct, not subthreshold primed in this comparison.
excitatoryMetrics: All v2 gates and pool density denominators use E only. Native growth, competition and pruning still involve the physical E+I pool. Prune-formed removes all physical pool->pool edges, including I edges. Report the complete typed audit separately.
controls: Growth-off, Hebbian-off, shuffled, untrained, prune-formed, continued-plastic, continued-Hebbian-off; all same inhibitory scaffold. Inhibition-off is the saved 500-E lateral-inhibition v2 primary, at its own stop and epoch120, a common reference rather than a matched-size toggle. Save once and reference explicitly.

reference.verified: Saved v2 primary summary/memory/trials/curve and continued-plastic summary/memory; byte hashes recorded before running.

measurement.edges: At every checkpoint: E->E, E->I, I->E, I->I counts and magnitude/signed quantiles; per-epoch births from native formed events.
measurement.trials: Capture window only, 50+J ticks. I cell IDs and spikes; per-E signed incoming charges, physical arrival times, refractory-discarded inhibitory charge.
measurement.inhibitionBeforeAfferent: Strict native message timestamp < first seed-afferent timestamp, among E with exactly one seed hit. Report both arrived messages and membrane-integrated messages (refractory drops excluded), fired IDs/fraction; simultaneous arrivals do not count as before.
measurement.charge: Unweighted sum of integrated inhibitory magnitudes divided by total E population, not only receivers. Separately report total excitatory charge.
measurement.proxy: For each E spike, raw integrated excitation minus inhibition over ticks [spikeTick-9,spikeTick], including current-tick inputs. This is an effective-threshold proxy, not a reconstructed leaky potential.
measurement.passivity: Non-enumerable native-method observers; no altered calls, return values, config or random draws. Compare observed vs unobserved native circuit bytes in tests.

confirmation: For every seed1 cell whose stopping criterion and all v2 gates including11 pass, run that exact setting on seeds2/3. No other settings. GO requires all gates and inherited required controls on all3 at one setting. If none passes seed1, stop.
exit: 0 diagnostic GO;1 scientific NO-GO;2 execution error. No automatic engine fork.
